scope: Wave 2 tools and standalone Glyph Studio. Page/source checks are not full export or device qualifications.

items.name: AutoCut
limits: Prior end-to-end evidence uses generated media, not a broad real-footage corpus
Beat, section and synchronization estimates can be wrong
Video export depends on browser encoders; Safari and Firefox are unqualified

items.name: Captions
limits: Transcription needs review
Model loading and processing depend on device resources
All-language accuracy and physical-phone export are unqualified

items.name: Board
capabilities: Print to PDF and timeline markers
limits: Generated planning suggestions require editorial review
This is not finished footage
Broad script-format and export qualification is outstanding

items.name: Grade
limits: Color matching is an approximation, not recreation of reference lighting
Cross-editor LUT round-trips are not independently qualified here

items.name: Split
limits: The initial model download is large
Separation may leave artifacts and needs device memory
Do not promise studio-perfect stems or universal phone performance

items.name: Key & BPM
capabilities: Batch key, Camelot and tempo estimates
limits: One global key estimate per track, not a key-change map
Tempo can land at half or double time
Results need musical review

items.name: Vox
limits: Intended for a clean solo monophonic vocal
Backing tracks and heavy reverb confuse pitch detection
Do not promise transparent commercial-vocal-processor quality

items.name: Canvas
limits: Exports are not automatic Spotify publishing
Spotify Canvas must be silent
Encoding and platform acceptance require separate checks

items.name: Pocket
limits: One 16-step bar per pattern and one bass voice
A sketchpad, not a full arrangement workstation
Phone audio and download behavior remain device-dependent

items.name: Press
capabilities: Artist bio, photo, tracks and links
limits: Exporting HTML does not automatically host it
Contact addresses do not imply a hosted messaging backend
Only publish artwork and quotes you have rights to use

items.name: Mockups
capabilities: Artwork placement on procedural product scenes
limits: Stylized procedural scenes, not photographic product renders
Fabric folds, weave and glare are approximations

items.name: Glyph (inside Luma)
capabilities: Install into Luma and font export
limits: Embedded version has polygon outlines, no curve fitting, hinting or kerning
Browser-installed fonts are not automatically embedded into saved Luma or PSD files
Distinct from the upgraded standalone Glyph Studio

items.name: Cast
items.entry: Model toolbar: Cast, or project menu: Open Cast
capabilities: Resin orientation guidance and prepared STL export
limits: Triangle-mesh estimates, not certification or a manufacturing guarantee
Cannot reliably detect every self-intersection or resolve overlapping shells
Caster/printer review is required
Canonical Form publish is outstanding

items.name: Glyph Studio
capabilities: Smooth curve fitting and kerning editor
.glyph projects, OTF/TTF export and Luma handoff
limits: Kerning exports to TTF only, not OTF
Browser autosave is not an account backup
glyph.thecreatingco.com still requires DNS and HTTPS verification

publicationSafety: Use exact live baselines and preserve functions, redirects and headers
Do not merge Sattari PR 23 until live-only plugin downloads are reconciled
No native release availability is inferred from browser tools
Keep the Attack Magazine pitch held
